artificial_contributor.role: reuse inventory, architecture synthesis and candidate verification

human_principal.input: Naja, wenn es real noch erreichbar ist, ist ja alles gut. Dann nehmen wir das auch, wie es ist und machen weiter. Letztlich müssen wir aber unabhängiger werden. Es kann jetzt nicht sein, dass wir von Railways abhängig sind. Das sind alles nur Zwischenstufen. Das Repository muss sich zum Schluss selber tragen. Und dieses Endsystem sollte sogar unabhängig von GitHub sein. Nur damit wir die Architektur Roadmap mal skizziert haben.
human_principal.name: Ingolf Lohmann

milestones.acceptance: Fresh own-host bootstrap from verified bytes; no Railway access; public monitor/terminal use and exact runtime readback; restart preserves confirmed data.
milestones.name: SELF_HOSTED_NODE_PACKAGE

milestones.acceptance: Native repository event to bounded authorized job, durable artifact, approved effect and fresh readback without GitHub Actions or a chat client; reject stale approval and competing writers.
milestones.name: NODE_LOCAL_EXECUTOR_AND_REPOSITORY_CONTROL

milestones.acceptance: Three storing replicas, declared one-node failure bound; retained acknowledged bytes/effects, replay after lost responses and partition recovery, no duplicate effect and no concurrent admitted writer.
milestones.name: DURABLE_MESH_REPLICATION_AND_FAILOVER

milestones.acceptance: With GitHub and Railway unreachable, restore a fresh node from Mesh-owned bytes and complete bootstrap, identity, build, review, update, public runtime use and effect readback.
milestones.name: PROVIDER_WITHDRAWAL_ACCEPTANCE

next_work_unit.action: Reuse the monitor candidate and terminal carrier to bind a portable start/runtime/volume/auth/readback package; separate the standalone runtime profile from the blanket GitHub-CLI bootstrap check.
runtime_admission_dependencies: exact reviewed source and runtime binding
identified persistent storage and public routing
authorized host identity and unchanged role/effect boundaries

reuse_evidence: Existing productization and open multi-node architecture roadmaps
Existing AI bootstrap, local Git object identity and integrity authorities
Existing runtime/toolchains cache and provision contracts
Existing Effect-Ack, private CAS/replay and Firefox terminal contracts
reuse_insufficiency: The existing roadmap has no milestones for withdrawing hosting and source-control platforms. The local workflow controller plans; its Action wrapper owns actual dispatch. The current runtime bootstrap checks GitHub CLI in every profile. The monitor candidate supports one writer per state directory, without cross-node replication. Extend existing contracts rather than introduce a parallel executor or ledger here.
